_about: Scheduler priority and reasoning by AUTHENTICATED identity (D-053, D-054). Keys are LiteLLM key aliases (live list read 2026-10-16), stamped into X-GX-Identity and HMAC-signed by gx_budget_hook; an unsigned identity is anonymous. On EVERY deployment: X-GX-Priority / X-GX-Reasoning that LOWER the mode default are always honoured; RAISING needs may_set_priority (capped at max_priority) or may_raise_reasoning; X-GX-Profile that cycles the V4.1 engine needs may_set_profile. 'health' is the reserved Odin lane (pinned, never reachable by header). Loader: gx_orchestrator/identity.py.

ai-os._why: owner work orders may wake the primary after a failure (owner decision 2026-10-16)

agentos._why: AgentOS model tests (model_admin.py _openai_headers sends X-GX-Priority: interactive): an owner-admin action

gx-operator._why: operator key: diagnostics, explicit V4.1 profile changes

odin._why: reserved health lane; no live key with this alias yet (create it in LiteLLM as 'odin')

open-webui._why: human chat: the mode default (gx-fast is already interactive)
